business_summary: Merck & Co., Inc. (NYSE: MRK) is a large diversified global pharmaceutical company. On the h5n1-panzootic chain it sits on animal-health-vaccines: Merck Animal Health is named among the large poultry-vaccine makers in trade coverage, and the parent discloses avian influenza in its own 10-K, but the placement's own role text calls this exposure 'heavily diluted inside a large pharmaceutical issuer.' The link is scored UNDISCOVERED (impact 70, crowdedness 34, capture 40, as of 2026-09-10) with the same 'option with a large payoff and an unlit fuse' framing as the other three names on this link: value is contingent on a USDA authorization decision for commercial poultry vaccination that has not been made. MRK is by far the largest and most diluted name on this link: FY2025 revenue of 65,011,000,000 dwarfs Zoetis (9,467,000,000), Elanco (4,715,000,000) and Phibro (1,518,093,000), none of which break out an animal-health or HPAI-specific segment either.

exposure_summary.narrative: MRK holds 1 ACTIVE placement on h5n1-panzootic (animal-health-vaccines, link position 5, UNDISCOVERED, money_corner false). No Merck-Animal-Health-specific or HPAI-vaccine-specific share of MRK's consolidated revenue is disclosed; Merck reports by Pharmaceutical and Animal Health segments in aggregate, not by pathogen.
